title: Cutting refused COD orders on a Shopify store
summary: A fashion store selling mostly cash on delivery was losing margin to refused parcels and slow mobile checkout. We rebuilt the store, added WhatsApp order confirmation and fixed ad tracking so Meta optimised for real orders.
problem: A large share of COD orders were refused at the door, paying courier fees both ways. The theme was slow on mobile, and Meta was optimising for purchases that never turned into revenue.
built: A rebuilt Shopify store on a fast theme, designed mobile first
Automatic WhatsApp order confirmation before dispatch, with unconfirmed orders held
Courier integration and order tagging for confirmed, cancelled and refused orders
Meta Conversions API sending only confirmed orders as purchases
Abandoned cart and post-purchase flows on WhatsApp
